title: Global Cleartext Traffic Allowed in AndroidManifest.xml
description: The Android application manifest sets `android:usesCleartextTraffic="true"` on the `<application>` tag without a restricting `network_security_config.xml`, permitting arbitrary unencrypted HTTP connections.
attack_vector: A Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacker on a shared Wi-Fi network performs ARP spoofing or DNS hijacking to downgrade or intercept unencrypted HTTP traffic transmitted by the app.
fix_rationale: Set `android:usesCleartextTraffic="false"` in `AndroidManifest.xml` and attach an explicit `@xml/network_security_config` enforcing HTTPS/TLS across all domains.
